## Disposition and attribution

Accept **30000160 / OWR-782-001** and duplicate **30000161 / OWR-782-002** as covered by the intended, corrected level-one conjecture proved in Alper Ferudun's 1 October 2026 [version 1.0 note](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23071924), Theorem 1.2 and Corollary 1.3. The note is explicitly unrefereed and AI-assisted. This is a credited audit of a prior argument, with **zero new proof-search turns**, no novelty or first-proof claim, and no claim of journal peer review.

The conjecture is credited to Bannai, Koike, Shinohara, and Tagami; the classical inputs to Swinnerton-Dyer and Serre; and the Hasse-invariant interpretation to Deligne.

## Accepted mathematics

The complete audit retains the integral coefficient lattice, denominator handling, full-space Hecke construction of an actual modular root, exact minimal-weight filtration, small-prime and constant cases, exceptional weights 2 modulo 12, and coefficient-vanishing endpoints. It establishes an integral smaller-weight extremal g already at r=1, every intermediate exponent, and maximal iteration. Uniqueness concerns the reduction, not the characteristic-zero lift or its weight. Both parts of corrected Conjecture 4 and the duplicate's stronger wording are covered.

The original Case (2) divisibility sign is explicitly corrected to p divides a_i for p not dividing i, consistently with the [2006 journal abstract](https://www.mathnet.ru/eng/mmj245). The separate OWR Theorem 3 is false as printed at k=12,p=13. Identifying its missing exclusion is not a claim to have repaired that entire auxiliary theorem.

The full 2006 journal article and the separate Katz and Swinnerton-Dyer papers were not read in full. The exact relevant classical statements were checked in Serre's primary exposition. No arbitrary-level extension, arbitrary coefficient-field result, non-extremal starting-form theorem, characteristic-zero equality, or global priority certification is claimed.

## Canonical publication

Adds exactly six files under unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30000160/: README.md, AUDIT.md, ACCEPTANCE.md, SOURCE_METADATA.json, STATUS.json, and MANIFEST.json. Duplicate 30000161 is covered by links and scope statements in this canonical account. No duplicate attempt directory or QUEUE.md edit is included.

The complete written mathematics and noncomputational inspection limits remain available in AUDIT.md. SOURCE_METADATA.json records public scholarly-source titles, URLs, manuscript status, PDF identities, and the originating audit's retrieval/inspection history.

Edition manifest SHA-256: 12fb51f383b37bc65968b165f31bb94ac506ff8296e09230d7316c80d3757517.

This is a draft checkpoint; no merge, release, DOI creation, or external outreach is requested.
title: 30000160: audited prior resolution of extremal modular forms conjecture
